stem.text: The formula for the upthrust on a block of wood partially submerged in water is shown.
What do the symbols $\rho$ and $V$ represent?

A.text: density of water; volume of whole block

B.text: density of water; volume of block below surface of water

C.text: density of wood; volume of whole block

D.text: density of wood; volume of block below surface of water

B: volume of block below surface of water
D: volume of block below surface of water
